findings.message: Rule-bearing legacy code in Freight.Rules.dimensionalDivisor matches no observation and cites no authority: decimal literal 5000.0 (line 6). Value 5000 equals DEC-FR01.p1 (superseded by DEC-FR04). The code still carries a superseded decision's value. Question for Network Operations: which accepted record, if any, authorizes it? New work must not reuse it until answered; the legacy code is left unchanged.
